# Swift Sail Shipping L.L.C.
> Freight forwarder and customs broker in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, founded in 2011.

Swift Sail Shipping L.L.C. arranges sea freight (FCL and LCL), air freight, UAE customs clearance and project cargo for importers, exporters and re-exporters. It works through Jebel Ali Port, Port Khalid Sharjah, Khalifa Port, Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Dubai World Central (DWC).

## Key facts
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 55 342 4700
- Email: info@swiftsailship.com
- Office: Tanvi Business Centre, M-101, Abu Hail, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Hours: Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00, Saturday 09:00 to 14:00 (Dubai time)
- Quotes: within two business hours during office hours

## Services
- [Sea freight](https://www.swiftsailship.com/services#ocean-freight): full container (FCL), shared container (LCL), reefer, flat rack and open top
- [Air freight](https://www.swiftsailship.com/services#air-cargo): express and consolidated air cargo, temperature-controlled cargo, dangerous goods
- [Customs clearance](https://www.swiftsailship.com/services#customs-clearance): Dubai Customs Mirsal 2 declarations, free zone transfers, permits, HS code classification
- [Project cargo](https://www.swiftsailship.com/services#breakbulk-project): out-of-gauge containers, RoRo, heavy road transport
